comparison: Both address dominant negative effects of HAQ/AQ alleles (C61-C63). OpenEval finds the dose-dependent dominance SUPPORTED by Figure 1G data, while peer reviewers also SUPPORT this finding, with Reviewer 1 acknowledging the dominant negative effect though questioning the mechanistic basis.

OpenEval finds this SUPPORTED with some speculative inference, while peer reviewers rate it UNCERTAIN, with Reviewer 1 stating 'the data collectively does not support a unified model' and 'neither mechanism is clear.'

OpenEval rates C125 SUPPORTED but C126 UNCERTAIN (speculative fatty acid metabolism hypothesis), while peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, accepting differential rescue but not explicitly evaluating the mechanistic speculation.
